g.text: Only the Lowest Number Holds the Lock
Four clients race for one lock -- sequential ephemeral znodes turn the race into a strict, fair order.
What if every waiter watched the lock-holder node directly, instead of just the node ahead of it?
All 3 waiters wake on every release.
Most re-check, find they're still not
lowest, and re-register a new watch --
wasted wakeups scale with queue depth.
✓ Each Waits On Its Predecessor Only
Exactly one waiter wakes up per
Sequential ephemeral nodes turn lock contention into a strict, fair order --
watching only the node ahead of you is what keeps a release cheap no matter how deep the queue gets.
